boards.title: Your First Weekend at Molloy University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend sequence that begins with campus orientation and connection, then leaves room for arts, study, and a nearby outdoor outing.

cards.title: Begin with New Student Orientation
cards.subtitle: Arrival and campus introductions
cards.notes: Register for the applicable session, meet Orientation Leaders, and use the day to identify the campus offices and resources you may need later.
cards.short_summary: A structured starting point for meeting people and learning campus basics.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy describes New Student Orientation as a program that connects new students with peer leaders, staff, faculty, administrators, campus resources, and the Dominican tradition.
cards.access_notes: Registration is required; consult the current orientation page for the session applicable to you.

cards.title: Get oriented at Public Square
cards.subtitle: Campus hub at 1000 Hempstead Avenue
cards.notes: Use the building as a practical waypoint: Student Affairs is in Public Square 330, and the building also contains the Madison Theatre and student lounge.
cards.short_summary: A named campus building that connects several first-weekend destinations.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy's Campus Life page identifies the Public Square Building as home to the Quinn Student Lounge and the Madison Theatre; Student Affairs lists its office as Public Square 330.
cards.source_title: Campus Life | Molloy University Lion's Den
cards.access_notes: Use campus signage and current visitor guidance when entering campus buildings.

cards.title: Take a pause in Quinn Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Public Square Building
cards.notes: After meeting people, make this your regrouping stop: compare schedules, look over upcoming programs, or arrange a next campus activity together.
cards.short_summary: A named lounge for a calm transition between orientation and evening plans.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy's Campus Life page lists the Quinn Student Lounge among the study areas, meeting spaces, and lounges in the Public Square Building.
cards.source_title: Campus Life | Molloy University Lion's Den
cards.access_notes: Confirm building access and lounge availability with current campus staff.

cards.entity_name: Welcome Back BBQ & Fall Involvement Fair
cards.title: Meet campus groups at the Welcome Back BBQ
cards.subtitle: Signature fall-semester program
cards.notes: If it falls during your first weekend, use the fair to speak with club representatives and save a few organizations to investigate after the event.
cards.short_summary: A recurring fall program that combines food, entertainment, and club discovery.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy identifies the Welcome Back BBQ & Fall Involvement Fair as an annual signature event for meeting students, exploring clubs and organizations, and enjoying food and entertainment.
cards.source_title: Signature Events and Programs | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: Check MolloyLife or CORQ for the current date, location, and participation details.

cards.title: Choose one Welcome Week program
cards.subtitle: Recurring semester-opening activities
cards.notes: Review the current program listing, choose one activity that fits your interests, and use it as an easy reason to reconnect with people from orientation.
cards.short_summary: A flexible way to add one university-run activity to the first weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy lists Fall & Spring Welcome Weeks among its annual signature events and says they are designed to help new and returning students connect with the campus community.
cards.source_title: Signature Events and Programs | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: Specific programs vary; consult the current MolloyLife listing or CORQ before going.

cards.title: Make a short club list at the Involvement Fair
cards.subtitle: Recurring student-organization fair
cards.notes: Ask two or three organizations about their next meeting, then note their names and contact paths before leaving so following up stays simple.
cards.short_summary: A recurring fair for finding recognized campus organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy says its Fall and Spring Involvement Fair lets students meet student leaders, discover opportunities, and find ways to get involved; dates are posted on MolloyLife and CORQ.
cards.access_notes: Event dates and details are posted through MolloyLife and the CORQ app.

cards.title: Join a Bingo or Trivia Night
cards.subtitle: Recurring Student Involvement program
cards.notes: Bring a few new contacts from orientation, confirm the current listing, and treat the activity as a relaxed way to learn what campus programming feels like.
cards.short_summary: A recurring, under-21-safe social program built around friendly competition.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy lists Bingo & Trivia Nights as annual signature events, describing them as friendly competition with prizes and time with friends.
cards.source_title: Signature Events and Programs | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current date, location, and event rules through MolloyLife or CORQ.

cards.title: Check the Madison Theatre calendar
cards.subtitle: Public Square Building, Molloy campus
cards.notes: Browse the current calendar, select an age-appropriate performance that fits your weekend, and review ticketing and accessibility details before committing.
cards.short_summary: A 550-seat campus theatre with programming across several performance forms.
cards.evidence_claim: Madison Theatre at Molloy University states that its 550-seat venue hosts theatre, music, dance, cabaret, comedy, and other performances.
cards.source_title: About | Madison Theatre at Molloy University
cards.access_notes: Programs and ticket requirements vary by performance; consult the current theatre calendar and box office information.

cards.title: Set up a study-and-browse stop at RVC Library
cards.subtitle: 221 N. Village Ave., Rockville Centre
cards.notes: Use the library's current hours to plan a focused reading break, browse its event calendar, or ask staff about obtaining a card and available services.
cards.short_summary: A nearby public library with study-friendly resources, programs, and a current online calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rockville Centre Public Library lists its address, current hours, event calendar, catalog, online learning resources, and material-borrowing services.
cards.access_notes: Review the library's current hours and card-eligibility requirements before visiting or borrowing materials.

cards.title: Finish with a daylight walk at Hempstead Lake
cards.subtitle: 1000 Lake Drive, West Hempstead
cards.notes: Pick a marked trail or observation area, go during daylight, and check the state park page for current entry conditions, weather, and trail guidance.
cards.short_summary: A nearby state park with trails, picnic areas, and views of Hempstead Lake.
cards.evidence_claim: New York State Parks lists hiking and biking trails, picnic areas, an observation deck, and other outdoor amenities at Hempstead Lake State Park, open sunrise to sunset year-round.
cards.source_title: Hempstead Lake State Park | New York State Parks
cards.access_notes: Open year-round from sunrise to sunset; the official page lists seasonal vehicle-entry fees and advises checking current conditions.
